verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents its own ability to plug in third-party integrations through MCP. It connects to hundreds of external tools, including partner-hosted servers such as Notion's, and there is a plugin mechanism (an official mcp-server-dev plugin). However, the evidence shows third-party tools and data sources rather than partner-built agent apps, and it does not document a partner marketplace or app-listing ecosystem. Missing for 10: evidence of integrating partner-built agent apps (not just tools), a documented partner app marketplace or directory, and independent hands-on corroboration of partner integrations in team workflows.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows

citations.quote: Claude Code can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
With MCP, Claude Code can read your design docs in Google Drive, update tickets in Jira, pull data from Slack, or use your own custom tooling.
You can also have Claude scaffold a server for you with the official mcp-server-dev plugin
